description: Database query budgets. Track in Supabase dashboard / pg_stat_statements; CI uses browse RPC harness when secrets exist.
rules: Prefer indexed filters on influencers/creators browse paths (recency, country, platform).
Fail review if EXPLAIN shows Seq Scan on tables > 50k rows for hot paths without justification.
Avoid large joins in request path; pre-aggregate or use RPC with limited columns.
Discovery browse must use browse_influencer_ids_by_recency (or successor) — never unbounded select *.
Log RPC wall time in measure:discovery-browse-pool; hard fail when source != rpc in CI with secrets.
